newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: FOREIGN MINISTER SET FOR VISBY CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: FOREIGN MINISTER SET FOR VISBY CONFERENCE.

text.p: Lithuanian Foreign Minister Algirdas Saudargas left for Visby, Sweden to take part in a German-Swedish conference on European security to show Lithuania's determination for full NATO and EU membership.

"The participation of the minister at the conference with a month left before the NATO Madrid summit is another chance...to show Lithuania's resolution to seek quick and full membership of EU and NATO," the foreign ministry said in a statement.
It also said that Saudargas will deliver a report at the June 7-8 conference on Lithuania's place in Europe in 2000.
